reviews.x: Great for removing sunscreen/makeup and oil cleansing. Plus I like the scent and feel of it. Washes off nicely and doesn't irritate my skin.

You are supposed to be able to use cleansing oils to remove ALL makeu

I use this oil cleanser before I use a gentle hydrating cleanser in a method called "double cleansing." I cannot believe how much better my skin is now. The first three pictures are before, the next three pictures are two weeks later. My skin is unbelievably smooth and hydrated now! I cannot get over the difference adding this oil before my cleanser makes.  I never would have thought adding an oil cleanser would make my super oily skin this healthy looking.

reviews.t: My skin seems to like this product...
reviews.x: I've only used this a few times so far, but so far, so good.  It does a great job removing make-up gently...including eye make-up.  Since it's oil based, I was worried it would break me out.  I'm 41, but my skin is very sensitive and I'm still prone to break-outs, particularly in my t-zone area.  Thankfully, so far, my skin seems to be liking this product.  I do think it's a little pricey for the size of the bottle you receive, but overall, I'm pleased.

I can't express how much I love this product! I use this every night to get off all my makeup at the end of the day. It smells like green apples and doesn't leave your face feeling oily. It leaves your face feeling fresh and clean!

I was looking for an alternative to the Seaberry Cleansing Oil I used all winter--it's great but very expensive. I purchased this and I like it. It can definitely be a little drying so its great for warmer weather but I probably won't use it in the colder months when my skin is much drier. It leaves my skin feeling super clean but I do think the scent is a little overpowering so just watch out for that. Overall, I'm satisfied with this purchase.

This product absolutely destroyed my skin.  After a week of using it my skin became extremely dry, very scaly and the skin around my eyes and nose started cracking.  Using this product was the only change I made to my routine so it has to be to blame.  I am now repairing the damage that was done.  Avoid at all costs.

Not the best remover I've ever had. The smell is overwhelmingly sweet when it doesn't need to be, and it burns if i get it in my eyes, which prevents it from getting all of my makeup off. It does it's job for the most part, and I never broke out, but i still wont he purchasing again.

Love this stuff! As a 30+ woman, skin health is a concern. This stuff takes off makeup really well. I still have to wash with other products for the final cleaning, but it does aid greatly in make up removal.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how effectively it removes makeup, including eye makeup, without irritation.
Many describe the oil as light, silky, and pleasant-feeling on the skin, with some noting it doesn't leave residue.
Several reviewers say it cleans pores, softens skin, and doesn't cause breakouts, even for acne-prone or sensitive skin.
Opinions on scent are mixed: some find it light and pleasant, while a few strongly dislike it.
A few reviewers mention their skin felt tight or dry after initial use.

qa.q: Will this clog my pores or cause breakouts?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate it does not clog pores or cause breakouts for some users, with one noting clearer pores [1] and another with acne-prone skin saying it doesn't break them out [6]. However, one reviewer reported severe dryness and skin damage [5], so experiences differ.

claims.text: One reviewer noticed clearer, smaller pores after use [1].
A reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin said it doesn't break them out [6].
One reviewer reported the product destroyed their skin, causing extreme dryness and cracking [5].

qa.q: Does it really remove waterproof mascara?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says it removes waterproof mascara, which is a big plus [2], but another says burning in the eyes prevents it from getting all makeup off [3].

claims.text: It removes waterproof mascara, which is a big plus.
It burns if it gets in the eyes, which prevents it from getting all makeup off.

qa.q: Is it good for sensitive skin and eyes?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer reports severe dryness and cracking around the eyes and nose [1], while others say it removes eye makeup gently and doesn't hurt their eyes as much as another oil cleanser [3][5], and one sensitive-skin reviewer says their skin seems to like it [5].

claims.text: One reviewer reports the product caused extreme dryness, scaliness, and cracking around the eyes and nose.
One reviewer says it doesn't hurt their eyes as much as another cleansing oil.
One reviewer says it gently removes makeup including eye makeup, and that their very sensitive skin seems to like it.

qa.q: Does it leave a greasy residue after rinsing?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says it rinses clean with no residue [1][3], while another notes residue with other removers but not this one [3]. No review reports a greasy residue after rinsing.

claims.text: It rinses clean with no residue left behind.
Other eye makeup removers left residue, but this one did not.
